g.text: Jev 1.13.0: accuracy vs calibration, one point per jev-bench config
Test splits: 1,000 records per config (2,000 civil_comments; 1,599 chaosnli). Bars are 95% bootstrap
intervals. Down and to the right is better; the shaded corner (accuracy ≥ 0.85, ECE ≤ 0.07) is where a
decision model earns its confidence. Unlabelled, inside the corner: arc_challenge, boolq, clinc150,
